subject: 松江兴圣教寺塔 · 方塔园 · 九层方塔
source_note: 全塔实拍用于底层柱廊和九层主体，另两图复核上部平座、木檐、铁刹及支链。参考有仰拍和暗部，重绘减弱透视、简化细节。1068—1093采用松江年鉴2019；较早2015年鉴列至1094，范围差异保留在年代来源中，年表使用约略排序点。
prompt:
Create a WHITE PAGE monochrome architectural illustration.
Draw the Songjiang Square Pagoda in exactly the NINE-tier shape of Image 2. Image 1 is a fine black contour drawing style sample. Image 3 is the real pagoda photograph. Image 2 is shape reference ONLY; its translucent grey material and halo are errors and should not be retained.
The entire 1024x1536 portrait page is completely filled with solid opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, alpha 255 everywhere. Then draw delicate BLACK INK STROKES on this WHITE PAPER. All wall and roof faces are white paper bounded by black strokes, not grey paint. All surrounding regions are white paper. This is a book page, with no transparency or shadow.
Keep exactly NINE separate tiled eave roofs: eight simple balcony floors and one broad columned ground-floor veranda roof. Preserve the square-plan tapering tower, straight horizontal timber railings, arched door outlines, narrow ringed iron spire and chains from Image 2. Keep its entire nine-tier silhouette, apex and bottom, centered with margins. Simplify the detail, use thin black contours and only a few roof-tile lines; much unmarked WHITE paper inside the drawing. No shading, grey fill, hatching, texture, glow, halo, checkerboard, text, vegetation or scenery.
